ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   D. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   C. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
